errors.text: The FEP mechanism is misstated as exponential averaging between solid and liquid states; the intended perturbation is from MTP-sampled phase ensembles to DFT for each phase, with efficiency controlled by the variance and phase-space overlap of MTP–DFT energy differences.
The proposed 5–10 meV/atom acceptance scale is too coarse to validate the subtle free-energy differences at issue; the target comparison requires approximately 0.5 meV/atom agreement.

The cited evidence supports general MTP construction and cost–accuracy balance but does not substantiate FEP melting calculations, liquid-phase fidelity, the claimed 10–100x acceleration, or the stated accuracy.
